fig:quadrant_experiment.caption: Held-out accuracy, calibration losses and sensing cost in a synthetic binary task. Dots show independent seeds; bars show 95% percentile-bootstrap intervals for seed means. Q3 uses extra observations; Q4 uses separate labeled training. Misleading metadata is a prespecified adverse control.
fig:quadrant_experiment.label: fig:quadrant_experiment
fig:quadrant_experiment.alt_text: Four panels show percentage accuracy, Brier loss, logarithmic loss and observations under seven sensor strategies. Distinct symbols and colors identify conditions. Small symbols are independent seed means; large symbols and capped bars show averages and marginal seed-bootstrap intervals. A key expands the Q codes into roles and implemented mechanisms. Observation use excludes separate fitting data.

fig:efe_sensitivity.caption: Exact single-step EFE for a binary symmetric likelihood, uniform state prior, identity transition and C=(1,-1). Information gain grows as observations become less ambiguous. Normalized EFE equals risk plus ambiguity; these are exact calculations, not confidence intervals.
fig:efe_sensitivity.label: fig:efe_sensitivity
fig:efe_sensitivity.alt_text: Two exact line plots decompose one-step expected free energy under uniform state beliefs. Information gain rises from zero to ln 2 as ambiguity falls; their sum stays ln 2. Outcome risk remains constant, while normalized expected free energy equals risk plus ambiguity. Distinct line styles identify terms. No empirical uncertainty is implied.

fig:resource_calibration.caption: Aligned accuracy and sensing cost with separated descriptive calibration views.
fig:resource_calibration.label: fig:resource_calibration
fig:resource_calibration.alt_text: Aligned rows compare percentage accuracy and observations using means, distinct symbols and marginal seed intervals. The fitted-model row is shaded to flag separate training. Two lower calibration panels use line styles as well as color; point area scales with bin population. Dashed diagonals denote agreement. These pooled curves have no calibration uncertainty bands.

fig:model_revision_map.caption: Conceptual taxonomy and executable revision cycle, not an empirical cognitive architecture.
fig:model_revision_map.label: fig:model_revision_map
fig:model_revision_map.alt_text: Four boxes repeat the full inquiry-role names and concrete operations. Below, arrows connect specification, exact execution, external evaluation and justified revision. These are overlapping conceptual responsibilities and a proposed procedural workflow, not a causal neural diagram or a demonstration of autonomous revision.

fig:paired_diagnostics.caption: Exploratory paired seed contrasts in accuracy, Brier loss and logarithmic loss.
fig:paired_diagnostics.label: fig:paired_diagnostics
fig:paired_diagnostics.alt_text: Six matched strategy comparisons are shown in three aligned panels. Points are mean paired seed differences and bars are marginal 95 percent bootstrap intervals. Accuracy favors positive differences; proper losses favor negative differences. No simultaneous coverage is claimed.

fig:stopping_sensitivity.caption: Exploratory stopping-threshold sensitivity at matched trials.
fig:stopping_sensitivity.label: fig:stopping_sensitivity
fig:stopping_sensitivity.alt_text: Two line plots show held-out accuracy and mean observations across eleven confidence thresholds from 0.5 to 1. Capped bars at the evaluated thresholds show marginal seed-bootstrap intervals; connecting lines guide the eye. A vertical line marks the original threshold 0.9. These reused test trials do not validate an optimized threshold.

fig:active_sensing_landscape.caption: Exact GNN active-sensing policy landscape.
fig:active_sensing_landscape.label: fig:active_sensing_landscape
fig:active_sensing_landscape.alt_text: Two heatmaps show inspection-minus-blind normalized expected free energy and inspection probability across reliability and preference logits. Negative score differences favor inspection. The outlined contour marks equal scores and inspection probability one half; a cross identifies the retained sampled design. These are exact GNN evaluations, not measured performance.

fig:active_sensing_outcomes.caption: Held-out action-task outcomes with exact reference expectations.
fig:active_sensing_outcomes.label: fig:active_sensing_outcomes
fig:active_sensing_outcomes.alt_text: Four panels compare sampled expected-free-energy policies with always-inspect and always-blind baselines on accuracy, proper losses and inspection counts. Strategy-specific small symbols are independent seed means, capped dark bars give marginal seed intervals and displaced open diamonds show exact expectations. The three strategies share the same generated trials.

fig:model_robustness.caption: Exact world–agent reliability mismatch and calibration.
fig:model_robustness.label: fig:model_robustness
fig:model_robustness.alt_text: Three exact score panels vary actual reliability while the agent assumes 0.85; arrows indicate favorable score directions and a vertical reference marks the matched world. Distinct line styles identify policies. A fourth panel uses different symbols and line styles for exact calibration at three world reliabilities. The model remains fixed throughout.

fig:quadrant_orientation.caption: Four questions in a meta-pragmatic practice of active inference.
fig:quadrant_orientation.label: fig:quadrant_orientation
fig:quadrant_orientation.alt_text: A conceptual two-by-two map labels all four roles in full: Q1 infer and act, Q2 contextualize evidence, Q3 monitor inquiry, and Q4 evaluate and revise. Task versus source evidence forms the columns; inference versus regulation forms the rows. Each role has a question, concrete operation and failure case. The responsibilities overlap.

fig:executed_models.caption: The two retained synthetic models and their evaluation boundary.
fig:executed_models.label: fig:executed_models
fig:executed_models.alt_text: A binary context feeds five potential sensor reports; percentage labels give the probability of reporting the true context. Brackets distinguish shared initial evidence from optional additional observations. A separate panel shows the four imported action states and mode-changing transitions that preserve context. Likelihoods, dynamics, preferences, prior beliefs and external scoring are explicitly distinguished.

fig:canonical_model_atlas.caption: Imported GNN likelihoods and dynamics, with explicit preference and prior vectors.
fig:canonical_model_atlas.label: fig:canonical_model_atlas
fig:canonical_model_atlas.alt_text: Three imported GNN models display likelihood A and two action-specific B slices, with cell boundaries and every probability printed. Columns in A are hidden states; B maps before-action columns to after-action rows. White marks zero support and dark blue probability one. Preference logits and prior probabilities are printed below. The single binary transition slice is repeated.
